exclude.why: wrong key: Vice-President but standard fact is the President nominated Anglo-Indians to the Lok Sabha (Art 331)
wrong key: Vice-President but the CPCB chairman is nominated by the Central Government, not the Vice-President
wrong key: K.C. Pant but standard fact is Jawaharlal Nehru was the first Chairman of the Planning Commission
wrong key: 'Legislature and Executive are independent' but in the parliamentary form the executive is responsible to the legislature
wrong key: 'Only 2' but standard fact is both statements are false (AG holds office at President's pleasure; enjoys MP privileges under Art 105(4)) - answer 'Neither 1 nor 2'
wrong key: Meera Kumar but the Rajya Sabha Chairman is the Vice-President; Meera Kumar was Lok Sabha Speaker
wrong key: 25 but standard fact is 21 years for a municipality member (Art 243V(1)(a))
wrong key: 'only to members' but privileges also extend to ministers and the Attorney-General (all entitled to speak in a House)
wrong key: twenty but standard fact is 50 electors as proposers (and 50 seconders) since 1997
